sources.mergePolicy: Checked-in corpus plus same-key public saved-admin replacement, matching Rawl loadPublicAnnotations; no contributor selection or signed-in/private data requested.

references.purpose: getPhraseStarts cumulative four-bar defaults and shifted boundaries
hypermeter page groups snippets by tag chapter/topic
live saved admin analyses override checked-in versions
manual saved grids override parsed grids
four-bar prior measures duration since preceding boundary, not bar modulo four

semantics.coordinate: Reference Rawl measures are one-based. MIDI measure grid contains the terminal boundary. Our roadmap startBar is zero-based. Reference seconds are never copied as quarter-note beats.
semantics.default: getPhraseStarts builds1,5,9,... plus a terminal/sentinel start. Four bars is a phrase duration, not an invariant original measure-number modulo four after an exception.
semantics.patch: Apply phrasePatch in stored order. Each entry finds the current boundary named measure, shifts it and all following boundaries by diff, extends the four-bar tail when needed, and restores initial1 if displaced. Patches are cumulative; they are not independent source-bar offsets.
semantics.positiveDiff: Lengthens the phrase preceding the shifted boundary; later four-bar phases move with it.
semantics.negativeDiff: Shortens the phrase preceding the shifted boundary; later four-bar phases move with it.
semantics.sections: Section values index the resulting phrase-start array; they are not bar numbers.
semantics.exceptions: Source tags distinguish extra-bar prolongations, repeated-measure extensions, fusion/truncation, altered default lengths and uneven spans. Harmonic change or a brick boundary alone is not an exception proof.
semantics.incompleteTail: Complete spans are measured only between two valid starts; final fragment and out-of-score sentinel are separate.
